Annotation Interface WithChaos

@Documented @Inherited @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({TYPE,METHOD}) @Repeatable(WithChaos.List.class) public @interface WithChaos
Activates chaos for a test, declared in the same JSON model as the agent's startup plan: either inline (value()) or from a class-path resource (resource()). The JSON is a whole plan ({"metadata": ..., "scenarios": [...]}) or a single scenario object.

Scenarios with "scope": "SESSION" run in the test's session (and so only for the test's own threads and the work it hands off); "JVM" scenarios apply JVM-wide while the test runs. Both are stopped when the test (method-level annotation) or the test class (class-level annotation, Spring and Micronaut) ends.

Honoured by the testkit's ChaosAgentExtension and by the Spring Boot, Micronaut and Quarkus test extensions. The testkit extension also binds the test thread to the session when the test declares scenarios; the framework extensions do not, so there a session-scoped scenario reaches the threads bound to the test's session (for example requests carrying its X-Chaos-Session header) and the work they hand off. 

@ExtendWith(ChaosAgentExtension.class)
@WithChaos("""
    {"id": "slow-db", "scope": "SESSION",
     "selector": {"type": "jdbc", "operations": ["JDBC_STATEMENT_EXECUTE"]},
     "effect": {"type": "delay", "minDelay": "PT0.2S", "maxDelay": "PT0.2S"}}
    """)
class RepositoryTimeoutTest { ... }
